decisions.notes: L-shaped corner with recessed panel on one face, visible consistent thickness and a plain adjoining face. The contact sheet and enlarged oblique show its shape from both sides.
limitations: Static untextured corner; one face is plain.
Stylized modular piece; assembly alignment and target-engine behavior have not been verified.

decisions.notes: A shallow square slab with a fine perimeter border; orbit, top, underside, clay and wireframe show a simple complete ceiling piece.
limitations: The slab is plain and untextured, with an especially simple underside.
Stylized modular piece; assembly alignment and target-engine behavior have not been verified.

decisions.notes: A complete straight flight with consistent treads, solid side walls and a plinth; orbit and wireframe views show the stepped geometry.
limitations: Static untextured stairs without railings; collision and walkability require target-engine setup.
Stylized modular piece; assembly alignment and target-engine behavior have not been verified.

decisions.notes: A thin blue door panel with two recessed panels, handle and hinge details, visible from both sides and in the wireframe.
limitations: Static colored door panel with no opening animation; pivot placement and doorway fit have not been tested.
Stylized modular piece; assembly alignment and target-engine behavior have not been verified.

decisions.notes: A shallow pitched roof segment with parallel raised seams; all sides, top, underside, clay and wireframe were inspected.
limitations: Static untextured roof piece; the underside is plain and roof joins are untested.
Stylized modular piece; assembly alignment and target-engine behavior have not been verified.

decisions.notes: A thick panelled wall with a full arched opening; both sides, edges, clay and wireframe show the opening and its surrounding structure.
limitations: Static untextured wall opening; passage dimensions and collision have not been tested.
Stylized modular piece; assembly alignment and target-engine behavior have not been verified.
